text: Near Kyoto, during [a civil war that drives the country to desperation|origin|a cruel society], an older woman and her daughter-in-law [ambush fleeing soldiers in the tall reeds|threat|people who kill], trade their armour for food and drop the bodies into a deep hidden pit. When the neighbour Hachi returns from the fighting, the younger woman slips away to him each night. To frighten her back, the older woman wears [a samurai's demon mask|images|dolls, masks and likenesses] taken from the pit, until, after a night of rain, [it will not come off her face|rules|the body changes].
